name: watch-together
description: Real-time video sync browser extension and its sync server

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.background.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.firefox.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.popup.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.test:server: npm --prefix server run test:node && npm --prefix server run test:vitest
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:dashes && node scripts/check-version.mjs && npm run test:server && npm run test:cf
scripts.safari:build: xcodebuild -project "safari/Watch Together/Watch Together.xcodeproj" -scheme "Watch Together (macOS)" -configuration Release -destination platform=macOS CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- -derivedDataPath safari/build build
